notes.title: Version 0.85 Beta
notes.content:
[list]
[*] New map: "[b]Collapsing Mines[/b]"
[*] New Challenge Level: "[b]Blackout[/b]"
[*] New enemy: "[b]Coalmole[/b]"
[*] Unlockable cosmetics (not all can be unlocked yet)
[*] Random map selection every 5 floors (instead of fixed order like before; the first map can only be Research Facility or Industrial Basement, then it's random)
[*] Larger maps the deeper you go (largest sizes appear from floor 40 and below)
[*] More enemies the deeper you go (up to a max of 4)
[*] Bug fixes
[*] Enemy "[b]Glare[/b]" has been removed until a better way to rework or redesign it is found
[*] [i]Possibly more that i forgot[/i]
[/list]

[h2]COMING SOON[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Mimic[/b] rework
[*] Possible [b]Glare[/b] rework
[*] New Industrial Basement enemy
[*] Cosmetic/Emote loot crates
[*] New hazard
[*] More achievements
[/list]
